newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tateho Chemical ask-only on financial worries.
newsitem.headline: Tateho Chemical ask-only on financial worries.

text.p: Shares in Tateho Chemical Industries Co Ltd were ask-only on Wednesday morning, depressed by Monday's announcement that the company's liabilities exceeded its assets on a group basis.
Shares of the chemical maker were ask-only at 324 yen at 0146 GMT, below Friday's close of 359. Trading of the shares was suspended on Monday. Tuesday was a market holiday.

Tateho president Tadahiko Handa told a news conference on Monday in Osaka that, on a group basis, the company's liabilities appeared to have exceeded assets by about 1.4 billion yen in the financial year that ended on March 31.
On a parent basis, however, he said debts did not exceed assets.

The company is expected to post a net parent loss of 1.26 billion yen and a current parent loss of 384 million yen in 1996/97, which the president said was "largely" in line with the company's estimates made last November.

Tateho also said on Monday that its U.S. subsidiary's liabilities exceeded its assets by 256 million yen at the end of March 1996, but added that the U.S. subsidiary moved into the black during fiscal 1996/97.
